$comment: Shared input/expected vectors for VfAvatar. The TypeScript rules in avatar/state.ts and the PHP mirror in packages/razor/src/Support/AvatarState.php both run this file. resolveAvatarBranch is enumerated exhaustively over the sixteen combinations of the three props plus the slot, because the fallback order is the component's public contract and a reordering that only shows up in one combination is the defect this exists to catch.

resolveAvatarBranch.$why: Nothing at all still resolves: the slot branch is the one with no condition.
The whole point of the chain: an image beats everything after it.
resolveAvatarBranch.label: MC

resolveAvatarBranch.$why: A label beats an icon. Reversing these two is the single most plausible port defect.
resolveAvatarBranch.label: MC

resolveAvatarBranch.$why: An empty image is falsy, so it does not select its own branch.
resolveAvatarBranch.label: MC

resolveAvatarBranch.$why: An empty label falls through to the icon rather than rendering an empty label span.
Every channel empty falls all the way through to the slot.
